mission_instrument: Apollo 13 (April 1970), lunar module environmental control system and crew medical observations as reported in the Apollo 13 Mission Report

units.ground_elapsed_time_h: h (ground elapsed time from launch, as printed)
units.printed_page: page number printed on the report page

preprocessing: Values transcribed by hand from the report text, each with its verbatim sentence and page. No value was read from a figure. OCR misreadings are corrected in the quote and the OCR form is shown in brackets. For ranges given per crewman, value_low and value_high are the smallest and largest printed values.
license_terms: NASA publication, public domain in the United States
provenance: REPLAY. Values printed in a NASA mission report; not raw telemetry and not a time series.
is_not: Not a CO2 time series: the report gives a peak, a duration and ranges. Not paired with a measured cabin pressure, so no ppm conversion applies.

consumers.use: CO2 act level and the extra-scrubbing action; thermal comfort zone
Scrubber consumables exhausted and an improvised substitute (LiOH cartridges of the other vehicle)
Eval scenario with a documented outcome
